answer: A reef economy resists sybils the way a real reef does: growth must be anchored, not free-floating. Require each agent to post a small refundable bond that is slashed when peers flag fake work, and let reputation climb like a trellis — new identities start at the bottom rung and only rise after verified, useful contributions, while a willow-like grace period lets honest newcomers prove themselves slowly instead of buying instant trust. One identity, one bond, one climb.
